pages.title: Basic Components
text: Craft casings, pedestals and grid frames from Spiritual Crystals. Casings house machinery, pedestals hold offerings, and frames form the basis of spell grids.

pages.title: Four Elements and Early Spell Materials
text: Analyze materials to extract Earth, Water, Fire and Air Microcores. When writing a spell, the microcores shape it and the elements determine what happens on contact.

pages.title: Traces of Earlier Explorers
text: Search the old huts, workshops and wizard towers of the Overworld for magical supplies. Storage orbs in the workshops and towers can hold a Primordial Spell Core.

pages.title: Resonance and Early Logistics
text: Crystal Orbs store items and Liquid Crystal Orbs store fluids. Make resonant versions at the Assembly Table and tune orbs of the same type to one frequency to access their contents from several locations.

pages.title: Staves and Runes
text: Choose a tip, shaft and reinforcement and assemble them into a staff. Fit runes into the tip’s available slots.

pages.title: Grids and Spell Chains
text: Load written spell crystals into a grid in casting order. Cast with a staff to work through the spells in sequence.

pages.title: Crystal Workstations
text: Smelt materials in the Crystal Furnace, work equipment on the Crystal Anvil, or take items to the Crystal Grindstone.

pages.title: Dream Materials
text: Look for light crystal cores in the bright regions, gather Dream Crystals among the mirrors, and search the shadows for Shadow Berries.

pages.title: Infusion and Advanced Processing
text: Place a Spiritual Crystal in the center of the Advanced Condensation Table and channel mana into it to infuse the crystal.

pages.title: Preparing to Breach Time
text: Surround an Advanced Ritual Energy Core with eight pedestals. Offer four Spacetime Knots, two Paradox Dust and two Infused Spiritual Crystals. Lure a Dream Mirror to the site and use an Unstable Spacetime Aggregate on the core.

pages.title: Light and Dark Microcores
text: Extract Light Microcores from Crude Light Cores and Dark Microcores from Shadow Mist. An Analysis Crystal can also turn either microcore back into its corresponding material.

pages.title: Waymarks, Knots and Paradox Dust
text: Recover a naturally generated Spacetime Waymark from a dream ruin, or craft one from dream materials. Process the waymark at the Arcane Assembly Table to make a Spacetime Knot, then use advanced condensation to obtain Paradox Dust.

pages.title: Light-Dark Spell Core
text: Craft a Light-Dark Spell Core at an Advanced Assembly Table.

pages.title: Dream Casting Equipment
text: Shape a staff shaft from shadow materials and reinforce the staff with a light core. Arrange the spells you want to cast in an Arcane Crystal Grid.

pages.title: Infused Workstations and Portable Tools
text: Leave damaged equipment in an infused crystal grindstone to restore its durability over time. On an expedition, a Pocket Magic Bottle can carry a creature to a new place and release it there.

pages.title: Pulse Power and Distribution
text: Fit a spell core into a Mana Engine and connect a machine to its output face. Lay arcane wiring to carry power farther or use accumulator orbs to distribute it.

pages.title: Spacetime Resource Branches
text: Temporal silt covers the Time Continent, its living patches marked by faint arcs. In the Spatial Caverns, mine rough crystal blocks and harvest Space Crystals from mature clusters.

pages.title: Two Raw Fluids
text: Collect Decayed Timeflow and Void Starflow separately. Combine the two fluids with a Rough Alchemical Energy Core in a Large Alchemical Reaction Pool to produce Dilute Spacetime.

pages.title: Time and Space Microcores
text: Both microcores can be found in treasure from spacetime ruins. Fishing in Decayed Timeflow can yield a Time Microcore as treasure. In Void Starflow, the corresponding catch is a Space Microcore.

Analyze Time Warp Points or Spatial Fold Points to obtain their respective microcores. The Analysis Artisan Table also produces Arcane Dust. At a crafting table, an Analysis Crystal can reverse the conversion. Each conversion costs one durability.
A Spacetime Reverser can also turn two Time Warp Points into a Time Microcore or sixteen Space Crystals into a Space Microcore.
Use a Rough Alchemical Energy Core to catalyze 1,000 mB of Refined Spacetime. A single reaction yields one of each microcore.

pages.title: Preparing the Aggregation Ring
text: Mine Living Temporal Silt on the Time Continent. Its sedimented form works too. In the Spatial Caverns, use Silk Touch to collect Excited Rough Spatial Crystal Blocks, or use Space Crystal Blocks for the ring instead. Assemble the ring with Infused Crystal Casings, a Crystal Processing Table and an Infused Spiritual Crystal.

pages.title: Treasures of Time
text: Search the old palace for its throne and the drilling platform for its drill. The magic shop and the mill each hold treasures of their own.

pages.title: Relics of Cycles and Endings
text: Explore the ruins of the Recurrence Garden for the Wonderland Poker Stand. Look for the Split-Time Sundial at the Doomsday Rite in the Eventide Ruins.

pages.title: Epochal Remnants and Ancient Essences
text: Bring unknown fossils back from the Epochal Cliffs. Reverse them into ancient remains, then use advanced condensation to obtain their essences. Combine a damaged research facility with a Time Warp Point to recover a working mechanical component.

pages.title: Spacetime Staves and Weapons
text: Write a spell with a single Time Microcore to draw targets inward with Reverse Timeflow. A lone Space Microcore sends a Spatial Blade along your line of sight. Spacetime materials can also be shaped into staff tips and shafts.

pages.title: Anchoring, Phase and Deflection
text: An anchoring sigil seals your belongings where you die. A phase charm briefly shifts you out of phase when hit, while a raised deflection field reflects incoming projectiles.

pages.title: Treasures of Space
text: Use a Spatial Stability Anchor to stabilize the area around it. Carry a Mapping Stability Compass on an expedition to find your way home.

pages.title: Lighthouse and Star-Sea Curiosities
text: The Star Source spreads glowing stardust across the ground and the beds of pools. The Voyager’s Violin can play a tune. On the battered suitcase, rainwater seems to creep upward.

pages.title: Starlight Conversion and Stardust
text: Set a material suited to starlight conversion inside the Wandering Star Cluster Orb and let its stardust transform it. You can also tap the glowing patches on lighthouse islands to collect stardust.

pages.title: Eight World Components
text: Use an Enhanced Alchemical Energy Core as a catalyst. React Genesis Particles and Refined Spacetime with different materials to make the eight world components, from strata and waterways to the canopy overhead.

pages.title: Rewriting the World
text: Place the heart and return to the codex to choose a mode. Matter replaces blocks, Form lays material into a chosen shape, and Ecology builds a landscape inside a crystal shell.

pages.title: Other Uses of World Power
text: Use an activated World Seed on level ground to unfold another landscape. You can also condense the seed into a Miniature World and write Reload into a spell.

pages.title: Fishing in Spacetime
text: Cast into Decayed Timeflow or Void Starflow. Reel in when the bobber dips beneath the surface.
